lede: Monday night, Telluride Town Council votes on the 2027 budget and property tax levy — and in the same session takes up second reading of an ordinance that would suspend the Open Space Fund's 5% cut of Real Estate Transfer Tax revenue for the year, a real trade-off worth showing up for. The school board also meets twice this week, including a Monday work session and a Wednesday regular meeting that opens with a debrief on November ballot results that will shape district funding. And if you need a break from civic life, the gondola reopens for winter on Friday.

notable.stake: Council votes on 2027 budget, mill levy, fee schedule, and Ice Park agreement.
